Pause follows earlier violations (Isfahan, Khorramshahr). Flight restrictions remain: airports in Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan closed. Military flights detected (RCH5017, C‑130).

  • Hormuz & shipping — Iran allows passage to friendly states (Russia, India, China); blocks others. Italy reportedly allowed US use of bases for the campaign.
  • Diplomacy & mediation — Pakistan mediating. US/Iran negotiators reported heading to Doha. Mixed signals: US says talks progressing; Iran denies direct meetings.
  • Cyber & other threats — One critical cyber incident detected. Houthis reportedly upgrading missile ranges during ceasefire periods.
  • International moves — NATO/European diplomatic frictions; operational support reports (airbase access).
🟢 Good News
  • 10‑day pause announced. Negotiators en route to Doha (Reuters).
  • Lebanese army deployment could reduce Hezbollah clashes on the short term.
  • Israeli radar AI startup clinched a drone‑warning deal for the army.
  • IDF sealed key Hamas tunnel (tactical win).
Threat assessment: Escalating

Situation Report — Day 27

  • Active: US/Israeli airstrikes on Iran and Iranian/Hezbollah/Hamas missile strikes on Israel continue.
  • Ceasefire/diplomacy: Trump announced a 10‑day pause (until Apr 6, 2026 8PM ET) on Iranian energy strikes. Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating. US/Iran negotiators reported heading to Doha; past 5‑day pause was violated by strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.
  • Northern Border (Hezbollah/Lebanon): Daily Hezbollah activity. Israel-Lebanon security annex text released; Lebanese army ordered deployed along full border. Reports of planned IDF redeployment from Lebanon.
  • Gaza/Southern Front: Israeli strikes continue inside Gaza. Civilian casualties reported and humanitarian tent fires. Plans for Gaza post‑conflict under discussion but timeline unclear.
  • Maritime / Hormuz: Iran allowing passage for Russia, India, China while blocking others. Risk to global shipping persists.
  • Air & logistics: Regional airports largely closed (Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan). NATO/European friction over support; Italy allowed U.S. use of bases for Iran campaign.
  • Cyber & tech: At least one critical cyber incident. Israel adopting new AI radar/drone warning tech (contract reported).
  • Other notable: Houthis reportedly upgrading missile range during ceasefire window. Russia informed UN about suspects in bus strike on Belarusian children.
  • 🟢 Good News: A temporary pause and Doha consultations offer a diplomatic opening; Pakistan mediation active.

Threat assessment: Escalating — high risk of continued strikes and regional spillover.
